label: Taobao
terms_note: Developer registration needs a STORE (non-personal) Taobao account with Alipay bound; item/order scopes need enterprise real-name (营业执照 + 支付宝企业实名); 商家自研 apps are company-identity only, code must run on 聚石塔, 5-10 working-day review; ISV route = 服务商认证 + 聚石塔 + 软著 + ¥100-150k deposit; test env 5,000 calls/day, prod default 1M/day.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: AppKey of your Taobao Open Platform (TOP) application (open.taobao.com console).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: AppSecret of the same application; signs every call as upper-case MD5(secret + parameters sorted by name as name+value + secret) and is never sent.

fields.name: session
fields.help: The seller's authorised session (access_token) from the TOP user-authorisation flow (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=102635&docType=1); sent as the `session` parameter. Update it when it expires — the runtime does not refresh it.

me.note: taobao.user.seller.get: the authorised seller (user_id, nick, type B/C, seller_credit, status).

list_products.note: taobao.items.onsale.get: the seller's items currently on sale (出售中), newest listing first; price in CNY (元). Items in the warehouse (instock) are not included, so the `status` input is not applied.

get_product.note: taobao.item.seller.get: one of the seller's items by num_iid with its SKUs (skus.sku) and description HTML.

list_sales.note: taobao.trades.sold.get: trades sold in the last three months, newest first (status WAIT_BUYER_PAY, WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS, TRADE_FINISHED, …; payment in CNY). `since` (ISO date/datetime) is sent as start_created in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss and is read by Taobao as GMT+8. The product fields are the first order line; `product_id` input is not applied.

list_refunds.note: taobao.refunds.receive.get: refunds buyers requested from the seller (WAIT_SELLER_AGREE, WAIT_BUYER_RETURN_GOODS, WAIT_SELLER_CONFIRM_GOODS, SELLER_REFUSE_BUYER, CLOSED, SUCCESS); `since` filters start_modified (GMT+8).

not_offered.create_product: Publishing needs the category-specific schema flow (alibaba.item.publish.schema.get → alibaba.item.publish.submit, listed in the 商品API group of https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=18&docType=2) with category, properties, SKUs and images; a name + price + currency cannot form a valid item.
not_offered.update_price: The 商品API group (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=18&docType=2) offers taobao.item.sku.price.update (needs the SKU properties/sku_id) and tmall.item.price.update (Tmall stores only); there is no plain item-price call for a Taobao item id.
not_offered.get_sales_stats: No aggregated sales-statistics API is in the TOP 交易API / 商品API groups (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=46&docType=2); revenue must be summed from trades.
not_offered.refund: TOP refunds are buyer-initiated: taobao.refunds.receive.get (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=52&docType=2) lists requests such as 'WAIT_SELLER_AGREE(买家已经申请退款，等待卖家同意)' that the seller answers; there is no call for a seller to refund an arbitrary amount on a trade.

adapter.terms: Taobao Open Platform (TOP) calling convention (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=101617&docType=1): https://gw.api.taobao.com/router/rest with method, app_key, session, timestamp (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, GMT+8, ±10 min), v=2.0, sign_method=md5, format=json and sign. Seller apps need enterprise real-name verification and, for 商家自研 apps, 聚石塔 hosting; buyer personal data is masked.

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, session; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
